text: If the zombie apocalypse starts on a cruise ship, and you're drifting into a storm...
you need the engines back. And they're seven decks down.
Rule one. Stay in the crew passages.
The passengers are just on the other side of that wall.
Rule two. Noise travels through metal.
Drop one thing on these stairs, and every deck hears it.
So you move slow. Really slow.
Run in the dark, and you'll miss what's right in front of you.
The engine room. Marco knows the start-up.
And the engines come back to life.
So does everything else on board.
